map.由物镜/目镜焦距、光学筒长与明视距离，按 M = (L/f₀)(D/fₑ) 计算: Compute total magnification by M = (L/f_o)(D/f_e) from the objective and eyepiece focal lengths, optical tube length and distinct vision distance.
map.由物镜/目镜焦距与镜筒长算总放大。: Compute total magnification from objective and eyepiece focal lengths plus tube length.
map.选物镜倍数配目镜。: Pair the objective magnification with an eyepiece.
map.有效放大受分辨率限。: Useful magnification is limited by resolution.
map.：镜筒长 L=16cm、物镜 f_o=1cm、目镜 f_e=2.5cm → M=: : tube length L=16 cm, objective f_o=1 cm, eyepiece f_e=2.5 cm -> M = (16/1) x (25/2.5) = 16 x 10 = 160x (25 cm being the distinct vision distance).
map.：油镜 NA=1.4 有效放大≈1000×NA=1400×；盲目加到 2000×: : with an oil objective NA=1.4, useful magnification is about 1000 x NA = 1400x; blindly pushing to 2000x only blurs without adding detail (empty magnification).
map.否。超过分辨率对应的有效放大（≈1000×NA）即空放大，细节不增反乱。: No. Beyond the useful magnification set by resolution (about 1000 x NA) it is empty magnification, adding blur rather than detail.
map.物镜倍数怎么选？: How to choose the objective magnification?
map.先低倍找视野再高倍，油镜(100×)需浸油提 NA，干用分辨率骤降。: Find the field at low power first, then switch to high power; the oil immersion objective (100x) needs immersion oil to raise NA, otherwise resolution drops sharply.
